rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality expanded/full blastocyst with dense ICM, cohesive TE, and thinning zona in a way that is broadly consistent with a 3AA embryo; minor overreach in discussing partial opening/hatching and 3AA vs 4AA nuance from a single still image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, smoking, endometrium, semen parameters, diagnosis, and lack of prior IVF failures with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors; slight weakness is some speculative interpretation of the male-factor label and morphology nomenclature.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading principles and standard IVF counseling, including SET recommendation for a young patient with a high-quality blastocyst; minor imprecision around expansion-stage terminology and implantation-rate framing prevents a perfect score.

Provides useful practical advice for proceeding with transfer, smoking cessation, peri-transfer optimization, and SET, but future cycle planning is only lightly developed and lacks more specific contingency planning.
